seo.title: Privacy notice — Ferrowind Partners
seo.description: Fictional privacy notice for the Ferrowind Partners portfolio demo. The contact form uses a mock adapter and sends nothing.

title: Privacy notice
intro: This is a fictional privacy notice for a portfolio demo. It is written to look realistic, but Ferrowind Partners is not a real company and this site does not operate a production service.

sections.heading: What this demo collects
paragraphs: The contact form is wired to a mock adapter. Name, email, company, and message stay in browser memory long enough to show the success state. They are not transmitted, logged, or stored.
Analytics is a no-op stub. Events are only passed to an adapter after you grant consent, and the default adapter discards them.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: The cookie banner stores your choice in local storage so it does not ask again. No advertising or tracking cookies are set.
You can clear the stored choice at any time through your browser's site-data settings.

sections.heading: Third parties
paragraphs: No third-party analytics, advertising, or CRM services are connected to this demo. Fonts are self-hosted at build time through next/font.
If this demo is later connected to a real backend or CMS, this notice must be replaced before launch.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this fictional notice can be sent to hello@ferrowind.example. The address is reserved for examples and does not receive mail.
